verses.en: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
verses.sm: Aua e te 10511051 i tagata amio leaga; aua foi e te 6a topa ia i latou.

verses.en: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
verses.sm: Aua ua mafaufau o latou loto i le sauaga; ua tautalatala o latou laugutu i mea e faatiga ai.

verses.en: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
verses.sm: Ua atiina ae le fale i le poto; a e faamausaliina i le faautauta;

verses.en: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.sm: o le poto foi e tutumu ai afeafe i oloa uma lava e tàua ma le matagofie.

verses.en: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
verses.sm: O le tagata poto ua malosi ia; ma le tagata atamai e tupu lona malosi;

verses.en: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.sm: aua o le filifili lelei e te fai ai lou taua; o le toatele foi o faipule e saogalemu ai.

verses.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.sm: Ua maualuga le poto i le vale ; na teletautala lava ile faitotoa.

verses.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
verses.sm: O le ua mafaufau e fai mea leaga, e taʻua o ia o le tagata fai togafiti leaga.

verses.en: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.sm: O le manatu o le vale o le agasala lea; e inosia foi e tagata le ua faatauemu.

verses.en: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
verses.sm: to Afai e te faavaivai i le aso vale,

verses.en: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
verses.sm: ua itiiti lava lou malosi. ii Ia e laveai i e ua puea la oti, ma e a oo ina fasia.

verses.en: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
verses.sm: Afai e te faapea, Faauta, matou te lei iloa lenei tagata; o le ua fuatia loto, na te le lagona ea? o le ua tausia lou agaga, na te le silafia ea? na te le taui atu ea i le tagata e tusa ma lana galuega?

verses.en: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
verses.sm: Lo'u atalii e, ia e ‘ai i le meli, auà e lelei; atoa ma le meli sisina, e suamalie i lou gutu;

verses.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.sm: ia e iloa, e faapea foi le poto i lou agaga; afai ua e maua, ona i ai lea o le iuga; e le iu vale foi lou faamoemoe.

verses.en: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
verses.sm: Le tagata amio leaga e, aua e te lamalama i le mea e nofo ai le tagata amiotonu; aua e te faatafunaina le mea e taoto ai o ia.

verses.en: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verses.sm: Aua e atu fitu ona pati lé amiotonu, a e toe tu o ia; a oe amio leaga, e pauu i latou i le malaia.

verses.en: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
verses.sm: A paú le ua ita ia te oe, aua e te fiafia i ai; a tausuai foi o ia, aua le olioli ai lou loto;

verses.en: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.sm: neʻi silafia e le ALII, ona leaga ai lea i ona luma; ma na faaliliu mai lona toasa ai ia te ia.

verses.en: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
verses.sm: Aua e te faameo i e ua fai mea leaga; aua foi e te losilosi i e amio leaga.

verses.en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.sm: Auā e le iu i se lelei le ua amio leaga; e tineia le lamepa a e amio leaga.

verses.en: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
verses.sm: Lo'u atalii e, ia e mataʻu i le ALII atoa ma le tupu; aua e te fefaauoai ma E feliuliuai.

verses.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
verses.sm: Aua e faafuasei ona tulai mai o lo latou mala; o ai foi se na te iloa le malaia mai ia te i laua uma?

verses.en: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
verses.sm: E i ai foi nei mea i e popoto. O le faailogaina o tagata i le faamasinoga e le lelei lea.

verses.en: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
verses.sm: O le ua fai atu i lë amio leaga, O oe le amiotonu; e fetuuina o ia e le nuu; e faafanoina o ia e tagata.

verses.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.sm: A oe ua aoai atu ia te ia, latou te fiafia; e 00 ia i latou le faamanuia e lelei ai.

verses.en: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
verses.sm: E taufeasogi tagata uma ma le ua tali atu i upu tonu.

verses.en: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
verses.sm: Ia sauniuni i fafo lau galuega, ma E teuteu ai i le vao; mulimuli ane, ona e faia lea o lou fale.

verses.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
verses.sm: Ana ne“ fai fua oe ma molimau j lē lua te tuaoi; e te pepelo ea i ou laugutu?

verses.en: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi e faapea ane, E pei ona faia e le tagata ia te au, e faapea lava ona ou faia ia te ia; Ou te taui atu ia te ia e tusa ma lana mea ua fai.

verses.en: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.sm: Na ou alu ane i le fanua o le tagata paie; ma le tovine o le tagata ua leai se mafaufau;

verses.en: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.sm: faauta foi, ua tutupu ae ua soo lava i laau tuitui, ua ufitia uma lava i le vao ogoogo, ma lana pa maa ua solo.

verses.en: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
verses.sm: Ona ou vaavaai lava lea, ma ou matuá manatunatu; ua ou iloa, ma ua aʻoaʻoina ai au;

verses.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.sm: seʻi toe itiiti sina moe, toe itiiti se matámoe, toe itiiti se piilima e taoto ai.

verses.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
verses.sm: A e 00 raai lou mativa e pei o le malaga; ma lou le tagolima pei o le tagata ua sauni lana auupega.
